title: Import
purpose: Upload a file, map its columns, fix the rows with problems, review and import with a receipt.
useWhen: People bring many records in from a CSV or spreadsheet file.
avoidWhen: Attaching files to a record; use DropZone with its upload queue.
alternatives: Use DropZone for attachments, and the review-submit contract for a short form.
requiredInputs: accepted file types and size limit
a parser returning columns and rows with line numbers
target fields with which are required
validation per field and the duplicate rule
an import job adapter with progress and cancellation where supported
transitions: upload → uploading → mapping, or upload-failed with Retry
mapping → fixing once every required field is mapped
fixing → reviewing; rows with problems are skipped
reviewing → importing → complete with a receipt
importing → cancelled or import-failed, saying what was imported
applicability: Importing many records from a file.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; an import that can't be cancelled omits Cancel and says so.
